source.note: common.md Frontmatter: the third line has the opening indent and `---`, so it closes the frontmatter, and the `---` line after it reaches the text, which is rejected.

error.name: Error
error.message: Diagrams beginning with --- are not valid. If you were trying to use a YAML front-matter, please ensure that you've correctly opened and closed the YAML front-matter with un-indented `---` blocks
